idempotency_declaration: 幂等必须 effect-based（查世界不信日志）— resume checks actual world effects before re-running a step; an operation log alone never decides what already happened (arch round-2 §2)

writer_input_contract.expected_revision: positive int — CAS optimistic-concurrency expectation; mismatch => revision_conflict with observed_revision, never auto-rebased
writer_input_contract.input_fingerprint: [0-9a-f]{64} SHA-256 hex of canonical normalized input (face 1)
writer_input_contract.evidence_refs: tuple of typed EvidenceRef (kind + value + optional validation), may be empty

writer_output_contract.code: RESULT_OK ('ok') or a closed error code (face 3)
writer_output_contract.new_revision: present ONLY on success — the released new version (五步流程: 释放返回新版本+结果码)
writer_output_contract.observed_revision: REQUIRED on conflict codes — caller re-judges against current state; meaningless elsewhere
writer_output_contract.execution: external-action state: succeeded / failed / unknown / None (nothing executed)

execution_invariants.ok: requires new_revision + execution (succeeded or unknown); ok+failed is contradictory
execution_invariants.validation_conflict_retryable: pre-execution rejections — execution must be None
execution_invariants.manual: may follow an executed action (源已提交投影待修复 => succeeded; push 超时 => unknown — check the world before re-running)
execution_invariants.conflict: requires observed_revision (CAS 冲突返回当前状态与冲突原因由调用方重判)

evidence_ref_kind_semantics.repo_file: exists in the named workspace/commit + path legal
evidence_ref_kind_semantics.governance_id: governance record exists with the expected type
evidence_ref_kind_semantics.url: syntax valid only — 默认不联网验证 (never an implicit network entry)
evidence_ref_kind_semantics.human_observation: non-empty content + judgement source explicit + never claims machine verification

reference_validation_vs_verdict: reference_validation (deterministic resolvability) is separate from verdict (whether evidence suffices — human/LLM); a CLI never derives 测试通过 from 文件存在
not_frozen_here: locking, re-validation order, atomic-replacement mechanics, dry-run flags — writer-internal detail (arch round-3 P1-1: M0 冻结跨票接口非全部内部细节; DoD §4 九条 applies at writer delivery)

result.detail: push timed out — check whether the remote already contains the target SHA before any re-run (恢复规则表: 先查远端再决定)
